description: AutoSUT demonstration of Caldera-driven dispatch on Linux. Every technique runs through a real MITRE Caldera operation against a sandcat agent registered live in the SUT container; no local recipes are used. The set is curated from Caldera's stock Atomic Red Team Linux abilities that are self-contained (no fact-source dependency, no parsers, no payload retrieval).

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.description: Enumerate root filesystem via Caldera 'List Directory' ability.

techniques.name: System Owner/User Discovery
techniques.description: Identify current user via Caldera 'Current User' ability (whoami).

techniques.name: Local Permission Groups Discovery
techniques.description: Enumerate group memberships via Caldera 'Permission Groups Discovery' ability.

techniques.name: Remote System Discovery
techniques.description: Parse known SSH hosts via Caldera 'Parse SSH known_hosts' ability.

techniques.name: Defacement
techniques.description: Drop a 'this machine was hacked' note via Caldera 'Leave note' ability.

techniques.name: Software Discovery
techniques.description: Probe for Go toolchain via Caldera 'Check Go' ability.
